name: Chaff
overview: The Bible uses the imagery of chaff to illustrate the instability and worthlessness of the ungodly, who are driven away like chaff before the wind (Psalms 1:4; Job 21:18). This metaphor conveys the ease with which God can disperse and judge those who oppose Him, as seen in Psalms 35:5 where enemies are described as chaff before the wind, pursued by the angel of the Lord. Isaiah further emphasizes the consuming power of God's judgment by comparing the destruction of the wicked to fire consuming chaff and stubble (Isaiah 5:24), and the swift dispersal of nations to chaff blown by the wind (Isaiah 17:13). These passages collectively highlight the frailty and ultimate defeat of those who reject God's law.
